package.name: kestrel_nav
package.description: Team wide-kestrel competitor package for the skybeta stack: plans the DroneHacks course from the published OBJ (coursenav planner), optionally refines the start pose with the coursenav particle-filter localizer, and flies the plan through /skybeta/setpoint/pose. Never touches /fmu/in/*; skybeta_flight_interface owns Offboard and the safety envelope.
